## Projects
- Pluto (AI & Robotics): an autonomous weed-removing robot. Best Paper recognition. Robotics, computer vision.
- Intelligent Traffic Signals (hackathon): real-time signal optimisation from camera feeds; Dockerised microservices, 85% vehicle recognition. Python, YOLOv5, Docker.
- Tasky: task orchestration service that schedules, retries and reports on automated jobs. Go, PostgreSQL, Docker.
- Go-Sim-Engine: lightweight deterministic simulation engine for stepping physics and agent models. Go.
- Go-ImagePro: concurrent image-processing pipeline (resize, filter, convert) for the command line. Go.
- Go-ASCII-Streamer: streams live video into the terminal as ASCII, frame by frame. Go, WebSockets.
- PrintSmithz: 3D-printing studio; custom parts and prototypes, from CAD to shipped part.
- Inkiniki: low-power e-ink display experiments. Embedded.
- Home NAS: self-hosted network storage on a Raspberry Pi. Linux.
